features: IMMERSIVE 7.1 CHANNEL AUDIO: TRONICA home theater system features a 7.1 channel speaker configuration designed to deliver wider, room-filling sound for movies, music, gaming, TV shows, and everyday entertainment.
POWERFUL BASS PERFORMANCE: Equipped with a 4 inch subwoofer and dual 3 inch passive radiators to produce enhanced bass, clear vocals, and balanced sound for an enjoyable listening experience.

MULTIPLE CONNECTIVITY OPTIONS: Supports Bluetooth, USB, FM, SD Card, AUX, and RCA connectivity, allowing you to connect compatible smartphones, tablets, laptops, TVs, PCs, and other multimedia devices.
RGB GAMING-STYLE DESIGN: Stylish RGB lighting on the main speaker adds a modern gaming-inspired look, making the system suitable for gaming setups, living rooms, bedrooms, and entertainment spaces.
REMOTE CONTROL & EASY OPERATION: Comes with a remote control and convenient front control panel for easy access to playback modes, volume, and other functions from a comfortable distance.
